Yes, the 30-day evaluation cycle is stricter than Part 2.2 requires.

The standard requires evaluation "At least once every 35 calendar days" [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec]. The operator's note explicitly states, "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows... The extra strictness is deliberate and is not a gap" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3]. Additionally, the operator's procedure confirms this by stating, "At least once every thirty-five (35) calendar days... shall review all approved sources" [isection-21a30e0d44708f5dfdce], while the note clarifies the actual execution is every 30 days to align with monthly change windows. Since 30 days is a more frequent interval than 35 days, it satisfies the "at least once every 35 calendar days" requirement with greater frequency.
